Mara L: Heads-up: planning a tiny nonbreaking change to /v1/rerank response - add `score_value` and optional `score_meta`, and keep `raw_score` as alias for one release. Need quick compat check before I open the PR. @Alex P @Jordan K
Alex P: Prefer additive. Keep `raw_score` as alias, emit a response_version header when we flip shape, and add a telemetry event `rerank.schema_change` (old_key/new_key).
Jordan K: Agree with additive approach. Also: can we standardize on `score_value` rather than `score` or `raw_score`? `raw_score` is ambiguous. Changing primary key is breaking so aliasing is safest.
Mara L: Proposal: add `score_value` + `score_meta`, keep `raw_score` for 2 releases, add header `X-Rerank-Response-Version: 2` after clients migrate. Also include `score_present` boolean to avoid null-number sentinels. Thoughts?
Samir: SGTM. Telemetry should capture `sample_count` and `tie_break_strategy` for the rollout analysis. I'll add those fields to the telemetry spec.
Alex P: Code-review ping: I'll take a look once PR is up. Please add unit tests for stable sort when scores equal (deterministic tie-break using rank_id/hash). Also add a small backwards compatibility test that verifies old clients still parse `raw_score`.
deploy-bot: FYI: canary staging env updated with v2 shape under feature flag `rerank_v2`.
Mara L: Example request/response I'm planning to include in the PR description:
```json
POST /v1/rerank
{ "items": ["snippet_a","snippet_b"], "context": "..." }
```
response (v2 shape):
```json
[
  {"id":"snippet_a","score_value":0.8721,"score_meta":{"model":"rwd-bert-2026","calibration":"none"},"rank":1},
  {"id":"snippet_b","score_value":0.8721,"score_meta":{"model":"rwd-bert-2026"},"rank":2}
]
```
Note: equal scores should fall back to deterministic `rank_id` hashing for stable ordering.
Jordan K: LGTM. Who owns the rollout doc + migration checklist?
Mara L: I'll draft rollout doc and migration checklist (include example parsing code in python/js, telemetry mapping, and dashboard steps). Pinging @Alex P for dashboard updates.
Alex P: Noted. I'll update the metrics dashboard and add an alert if post-rollout tie-rate > 1% (so we catch any accidental score normalization regressions).
Samir: ack, will sync telemetry schema with Mara's doc.
Mara L: Thanks all — opening PR after I add the tests and example parsing snippets. Will tag reviewers and the canary env. Please comment on the PR if you want different key names or a shorter deprecation window.
